<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="360" height="800" viewBox="0 0 360 800">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="360" height="800" fill="#D9D9D9"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="18" y="20" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="286" y1="16" x2="286" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="291" y1="13" x2="291" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="296" y1="10" x2="296" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="310" cy="16" r="3" fill="#000000"/>
    <line x1="316" y1="12" x2="322" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="322" y1="18" x2="328" y2="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="335" y="10" width="19" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="338" y="13" width="12" height="5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="355" y="13" width="3" height="5" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <line x1="20" y1="58" x2="340" y2="58" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="20" y="46" font-family="Inter" font-size="17" font-weight="900" fill="#000000">MONKEY SPEAK APP</text>
    <circle cx="326" cy="38" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="326" cy="34" r="3" fill="#000000"/>
    <ellipse cx="326" cy="42" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main instruction -->
  <g>
    <text x="180" y="116" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="30" font-weight="300" fill="#000000">Press the button</text>
    <text x="180" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="30" font-weight="300" fill="#000000">to record the sounds</text>
    <text x="180" y="186" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="30" font-weight="300" fill="#000000">of the monkeys</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Recording card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="43" y="222" width="277" height="279" rx="10" fill="#000000" opacity="0.16"/>
    <rect x="40" y="219" width="277" height="279" rx="10" fill="#D9D9D9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="180" y="253" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">READY TO RECORD</text>
    <line x1="77" y1="268" x2="283" y2="268" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- microphone / record graphic -->
    <rect x="160" y="291" width="40" height="82" rx="20" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="168" y="299" width="24" height="57" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="143,342 143,355 148,367 158,377 170,382 190,382 202,377 212,367 217,355 217,342" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="7"/>
    <line x1="180" y1="382" x2="180" y2="414" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="7"/>
    <line x1="160" y1="414" x2="200" y2="414" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="7"/>
    <circle cx="180" cy="330" r="8" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    
    <text x="180" y="452" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="300" fill="#000000">Capture a clear monkey sound</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Primary record button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="91" y="531" width="178" height="62" rx="31" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="88" y="528" width="178" height="62" rx="31" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="116" cy="559" r="13" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="181" y="567" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">START RECORDING</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Supporting content -->
  <g>
    <text x="180" y="628" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Tip for better results</text>
    <text x="180" y="652" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="300" fill="#000000">Move closer and speak naturally.</text>
    <line x1="24" y1="680" x2="336" y2="680" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="706" width="360" height="94" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="706" x2="360" y2="706" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- Home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="28,735 40,725 52,735" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="32" y="734" width="16" height="14" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="40" y="772" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Home</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Record selected -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="112" cy="737" r="17" fill="#000000"/>
      <circle cx="112" cy="737" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <text x="112" y="772" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Record</text>
    </g>

    <!-- History -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="184" cy="737" r="13" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="184,729 184,737 190,741" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="184" y="772" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">History</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Translations -->
    <g>
      <rect x="242" y="727" width="27" height="21" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="248,748 248,753 254,748" fill="#000000"/>
      <line x1="248" y1="734" x2="263" y2="734" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="248" y1="740" x2="259" y2="740" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="256" y="772" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Sounds</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="328" cy="732" r="5" fill="#000000"/>
      <ellipse cx="328" cy="745" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#000000"/>
      <text x="328" y="772" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
